description: Profile all nine P-loop positions across CDD subfamily members (Oca6 cd17663, Siw14 cd14528, Oca1 cd14531) using an ungapped BLOSUM62 sliding-window anchor, after fetching the three reference sequences explicitly
code:
import json, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, requests
from collections import Counter

B62 = """A  4 -1 -2 -2  0 -1 -1  0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1  1  0 -3 -2  0
R -1  5  0 -2 -3  1  0 -2  0 -3 -2  2 -1 -3 -2 -1 -1 -3 -2 -3
N -2  0  6  1 -3  0  0  0  1 -3 -3  0 -2 -3 -2  1  0 -4 -2 -3
D -2 -2  1  6 -3  0  2 -1 -1 -3 -4 -1 -3 -3 -1  0 -1 -4 -3 -3
C  0 -3 -3 -3  9 -3 -4 -3 -3 -1 -1 -3 -1 -2 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1
Q -1  1  0  0 -3  5  2 -2  0 -3 -2  1  0 -3 -1  0 -1 -2 -1 -2
E -1  0  0  2 -4  2  5 -2  0 -3 -3  1 -2 -3 -1  0 -1 -3 -2 -2
G  0 -2  0 -1 -3 -2 -2  6 -2 -4 -4 -2 -3 -3 -2  0 -2 -2 -3 -3
H -2  0  1 -1 -3  0  0 -2  8 -3 -3 -1 -2 -1 -2 -1 -2 -2  2 -3
I -1 -3 -3 -3 -1 -3 -3 -4 -3  4  2 -3  1  0 -3 -2 -1 -3 -1  3
L -1 -2 -3 -4 -1 -2 -3 -4 -3  2  4 -2  2  0 -3 -2 -1 -2 -1  1
K -1  2  0 -1 -3  1  1 -2 -1 -3 -2  5 -1 -3 -1  0 -1 -3 -2 -2
M -1 -1 -2 -3 -1  0 -2 -3 -2  1  2 -1  5  0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1  1
F -2 -3 -3 -3 -2 -3 -3 -3 -1  0  0 -3  0  6 -4 -2 -2  1  3 -1
P -1 -2 -2 -1 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 -1 -2 -4  7 -1 -1 -4 -3 -2
S  1 -1  1  0 -1  0  0  0 -1 -2 -2  0 -1 -2 -1  4  1 -3 -2 -2
T  0 -1  0 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1  1  5 -2 -2  0
W -3 -3 -4 -4 -2 -2 -3 -2 -2 -3 -2 -3 -1  1 -4 -3 -2 11  2 -3
Y -2 -2 -2 -3 -2 -1 -2 -3  2 -1 -1 -2 -1  3 -3 -2 -2  2  7 -1
V  0 -3 -3 -3 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3  3  1 -2  1 -1 -2 -2  0 -3 -1  4"""
AA = "ARNDCQEGHILKMFPSTWYV"
M = np.array([[int(x) for x in r.split()[1:]] for r in B62.splitlines()], float)
M = np.pad(M, ((0,1),(0,1)), constant_values=-4.0)
IDX = {a:i for i,a in enumerate(AA)}
enc = lambda s: np.array([IDX.get(c,20) for c in s])

D = json.load(open("cdd_three_fam_seqs.json"))
members, seqs = D["members"], D["seqs"]
S = requests.Session()
for acc in ["Q12454","P53965","P50946"]:
    if acc not in seqs:
        txt = S.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{acc}.fasta", timeout=40).text
        seqs[acc] = "".join(l.strip() for l in txt.splitlines() if not l.startswith(">"))

REF = {"cd17663": ("Q12454","Oca6",  113, 121),
       "cd14528": ("P53965","Siw14", 213, 221),
       "cd14531": ("P50946","Oca1",  167, 175)}
FLANK = 8
for cd,(acc,nm,a,b) in REF.items():
    print(f"{nm:6s} {acc} P-loop {a}-{b}: {seqs[acc][a-1:b]}   anchor window: {seqs[acc][a-1-FLANK:b+FLANK]}")
    print(f"       reference in its own CDD member list: {acc in members[cd]}")

rows, skipped = [], Counter()
for cd,(racc,nm,p0,p1) in REF.items():
    ref = seqs[racc]; ws, we = p0-1-FLANK, p1+FLANK
    win = enc(ref[ws:we]); W = len(win); selfscore = M[win, win].sum()
    for acc in members[cd]:
        s = seqs.get(acc)
        if not s or len(s) < W + 10: skipped[nm+":short"] += 1; continue
        t = enc(s); L = len(t) - W + 1
        sc = np.zeros(L)
        for k in range(W): sc += M[win[k], t[k:k+L]]
        off = int(np.argmax(sc))
        if sc[off] < 0.25 * selfscore: skipped[nm+":lowscore"] += 1; continue
        got = [s[off + FLANK + i] for i in range(p1-p0+1)]
        rows.append({"family":nm,"acc":acc,"anchor_score":round(sc[off],1),
                     **{f"p{i+1}":g for i,g in enumerate(got)}})
print("\nskipped (no confident anchor):", dict(skipped))

df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
POS = [f"p{i}" for i in range(1,10)]
LAB = ["H213/H113","C214/C114","N215/T115","R216/N116","G217/G117",
       "K218/E118","H219/L119","R220/I120","T221/I121"]
BASIC, ACID = set("RKH"), set("DE")
print("\nanchored members per subfamily:"); print(df.groupby("family").size().to_string())

frac, summ = {}, {}
for fam, g in df.groupby("family"):
    frac[fam] = [(g[p].isin(BASIC)).mean() for p in POS]
    summ[fam] = {"n":len(g), "Cys_at_p2":round((g.p2=="C").mean(),3),
                 "ST_at_p9":round(g.p9.isin(list("ST")).mean(),3),
                 "Gly_at_p5":round((g.p5=="G").mean(),3),
                 "basic_at_p8_CX5R_Arg":round((g.p8.isin(BASIC)).mean(),3),
                 "acidic_at_p6":round((g.p6.isin(ACID)).mean(),3),
                 "mean_basic_count_p3_p9":round(sum((g[p].isin(BASIC)).mean() for p in POS[2:]),2),
                 "p8_composition":dict(Counter(g.p8).most_common(5)),
                 "p6_composition":dict(Counter(g.p6).most_common(5)),
                 "p4_composition":dict(Counter(g.p4).most_common(5))}
fr = pd.DataFrame(frac, index=LAB).T
print("\nFraction of subfamily members with Arg/Lys/His at each P-loop position:")
print(fr.round(3).to_string())
print("\n" + json.dumps(summ, indent=1))

df.to_csv("ploop_full_profile_per_ortholog.csv", index=False)
fr.to_csv("ploop_basic_fraction_by_position.csv")
pd.DataFrame(summ).T.to_csv("ploop_profile_summary.csv")

from scipy.stats import fisher_exact
o6, s14 = df[df.family=="Oca6"], df[df.family=="Siw14"]
tab = [[int(o6.p8.isin(BASIC).sum()), len(o6)-int(o6.p8.isin(BASIC).sum())],
       [int(s14.p8.isin(BASIC).sum()), len(s14)-int(s14.p8.isin(BASIC).sum())]]
print("\n2x2 basic at p8 (Oca6 vs Siw14):", tab, "Fisher p =", fisher_exact(tab)[1])

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10,3.4))
order = ["Siw14","Oca1","Oca6"]
im = ax.imshow(fr.loc[order].values, cmap="RdYlBu_r", vmin=0, vmax=1, aspect="auto")
ax.set_xticks(range(9)); ax.set_xticklabels(LAB, rotation=40, ha="right", fontsize=8)
ax.set_yticks(range(3))
ax.set_yticklabels([f"{o} (n={summ[o]['n']})" for o in order], fontsize=9)
for i,f in enumerate(order):
    for j in range(9):
        v = fr.loc[f].values[j]
        ax.text(j, i, f"{v:.2f}", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=8,
                color="white" if (v > 0.65 or v < 0.08) else "black")
ax.set_title("Arg, Lys or His occupancy at each P-loop position, three Oca subfamilies", fontsize=10)
ax.set_xlabel("P-loop position, labelled by the Siw14 / Oca6 residue")
fig.colorbar(im, ax=ax, label="fraction basic")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
